claims.object_text: interaction via a forkhead-associated domain in PNKP
claims.quote: XRCC1 and PNKP interact via a high-affinity phosphorylation-dependent interaction site in XRCC1 and a forkhead-associated domain in PNKP.

claims.object_text: a second PNKP interaction site in XRCC1 that binds PNKP with lower affinity and independently of XRCC1 phosphorylation
claims.quote: Here, we identified using biochemical and biophysical approaches a second PNKP interaction site in XRCC1 that binds PNKP with lower affinity and independently of XRCC1 phosphorylation.

claims.object_text: stimulation of PNKP activity and promotion of SSBR and cell survival
claims.quote: However, this interaction nevertheless stimulated PNKP activity and promoted SSBR and cell survival.

claims.object_text: bipartite interaction model in which high-affinity tether promotes a low-affinity interaction that stimulates PNKP directly
claims.quote: We propose a bipartite interaction model in which the previously identified high-affinity interaction acts as a molecular tether, holding XRCC1 and PNKP together and thereby promoting the low-affinity interaction identified here, which then stimulates PNKP directly.
